## Implementation Steps
1. Open CLAUDE.md
2. Find rule 24 in the 'Always Do These' section:
   Anchor: "Never commit directly to the session worktree during sprint-active state"
3. Update the rule text to:
   a. Reference both .sprint-active AND .debug-active as the markers that trigger enforcement
   b. Document DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 as the debug session escape hatch (independent of DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE)
   c. Note AND semantics: when both markers present, both env vars must be 0 to permit commit
   d. Keep the rule concise — one sentence plus clarifier, no inline implementation details

Escape: DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 (sprint) or DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 (debug); when both markers present, both vars must be 0.'
